notes: Routes are the `InterpreterRoute` values in src/ai/orchestration/turn_interpreter.py. CLARIFY is never expected: `chat.turn_interpreter.clarify_enabled` is false in config/chunking_params.yaml, so expecting it would test a disabled capability.

`expected_resolution` describes the information need the resolved question must represent (EVAL_GUIDE.md §7.2). It is graded semantically -- never by string equality against the model's own paraphrase.
Turn 1 of most cases is a real answerable question so that later REUSE turns have a genuine answer to re-present; a REUSE turn after a fallback would test nothing.
